results.change_intent: Propagate the browser-level disable_security configuration to the default context configuration upon Agent initialization.
results.summary: Synchronizing browser configuration inside Agent.__init__ mutates injected browser state and is misplaced outside the Browser/BrowserConfig classes.

issues.comment: Synchronizing Browser configuration attributes inside Agent.__init__ mutates an injected browser instance's context config (even if a custom browser_context was already provided, or if new_context_config was explicitly configured). Additionally, this synchronization will not take effect when Browser is used independently of Agent.
issues.suggestion: Move configuration propagation into BrowserConfig (e.g. via model_post_init) or Browser.__init__, ensuring it only sets disable_security if not already explicitly specified on new_context_config.

results.change_intent: Switch the browser automation engine from Playwright to Patchright, fix context configuration defaulting, and launch Chrome by default.
results.summary: Hardcoding channel='chrome' will cause launch failures when using Firefox or WebKit, or in environments where Google Chrome is not installed.

issues.comment: Hardcoding channel='chrome' causes two issues: 1) It will raise a runtime error when self.config.browser_class is 'firefox' or 'webkit' because neither supports the 'chrome' channel. 2) Unlike bundled Chromium installed via 'playwright install chromium', channel='chrome' requires a system installation of Google Chrome and will fail if Chrome is not installed in the environment (such as in Docker or CI).
issues.suggestion: Only pass channel='chrome' if browser_class is 'chromium', or make the channel configurable on BrowserConfig so users can fall back to the bundled Chromium or other browsers.

results.change_intent: Switch browser automation from Playwright to Patchright for stealth/anti-bot evasion, adjust default user agent, and configure viewport settings based on headless mode.
results.summary: Replaced Playwright imports with Patchright, but when running in headed mode, viewport and no_viewport settings are omitted, causing Playwright/Patchright to fall back to an emulated 1280x720 viewport.

issues.comment: When self.browser.config.headless is False, neither viewport nor no_viewport is added to kwargs. Previously, no_viewport=True was passed unconditionally. In headed mode, Playwright/Patchright falls back to its default viewport (1280x720), ignoring self.config.browser_window_size (1280x1100) and preventing the viewport from matching the browser window. In addition, the existing self.config.no_viewport attribute is never respected.
issues.suggestion: Add an else branch for non-headless mode to preserve no_viewport=True (or respect self.config.no_viewport if specified).
